[
  "The licensed guideline corpus holds no recommendation for 'NEV'.",
  "The 7-point checklist score indicates melanoma suspicion.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ. (PMID:30392755, table-x-excision-first-line)",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness. (PMID:30392755, table-x-excision-first-line)",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor, and in the same operative setting, whenever possible. (PMID:30392755, table-x-slnb-timing)",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis. (PMID:39709737, recommendation-1)",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions and on the genitalia. (PMID:39709737, recommendation-1)",
  "The criteria driving the 5-point score are pigment_network (atypical, 2 points) and blue_whitish_veil (present, 2 points), both major criteria.",
  "Dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point) contributes the third point.",
  "An atypical pigment network appears as irregular meshes and thickened lines.",
  "A blue-whitish veil appears as confluent blue pigment with overlying white haze.",
  "Irregular dots/globules appear as varied size and uneven distribution."
]
